name: easy_gcode_plot
description: Easy G-Code Plot is a comprehensive desktop application for viewing, editing, and analyzing G-code files

paragraphs: Desktop G-code editor, analyzer, backplotter and NC/DXF exporter for FANUC turning/milling, SINUMERIK 840D milling (native and ISO-M), native SINUMERIK XZ turning with bounded ISO-T input, and HEIDENHAIN iTNC 530 Klartext milling. Controller coverage and configured kinematics are described in the FAQ.

Current 2.8.0 working tree: native milling cycles. HEIDENHAIN iTNC 530 executes documented subsets of position patterns 220/221, pockets 251/252 and thread milling 262. Native SINUMERIK executes classic POCKET3/4, HOLES1/2 with modal drilling, and CYCLE90. Cutter geometry and, for iTNC helical/reciprocating pocket entry, an explicit tool entry angle are required. Unsupported variants stop with diagnostics. See the FAQ for parameters and limits; these additions do not establish controller-identical internal passes or expand the output-post contract.

New in 2.7.0: native HEIDENHAIN iTNC 530 indexed 3+2 and continuous five-axis input. Execute PLANE SPATIAL/RESET and rotary positioning with configured kinematics; use M128/M129 or the supported FUNCTION TCPM form for continuous L motion on AC/BC tables. Opening .h/.H selects native Klartext milling automatically. Regression tests compare the supplied FANUC, SINUMERIK and HEIDENHAIN CAM programs across 1182 normalized cutting segments, including arc geometry and tool-axis directions. See the iTNC input coverage and limits. GPU milling stock removal remains three-axis.
